{{Youmay|Smuggler's Rest on Ruusan|other [[Smuggler's Rest (disambiguation)|cantina with this name]]}}
The '''Smuggler's Rest''' was the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Fort Nowhere]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].<ref name="jk">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

==Layout==
Every night it was the busiest and loudest location on the planet, typically serving twenty people on its dozen tables of different shapes. A useless [[fuel/Legends|fuel]] tank was used as the bar. The walls were decorated with random memorabilia. It had a drink [[gong/Legends|gong]] that sounded whenever someone bought a round of [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]].<ref name="jk" />

As Ruusan was a "lost" planet far from the [[Galactic community]], populated by colonists and [[spacer/Legends|spacers]], the [[music/Legends|music]] heard in the Rest was off-fashion by a couple of [[standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="jk" />

==History==
One time around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], on the eve of his [[Katie Grawley|dead daughter]]'s birthday, [[Grif Grawley]] "celebrated" by burying his grief with [[Old Trusty]] until he fell unconscious. His wife [[Carole Grawley|Carole]] was summoned to and with the help of some locals, they loaded him on their [[skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] to return home.<ref name="jk" />

Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Grif entered the cantina to meet [[Byron Devo III]] to warn him about an imminent [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Fort Nowhere|invasion]]. To gain their attention, he blasted the sound system, and produced the ID plate of the Imperial droid [[PD 4786]] which he destroyed earlier. His warning resulted to mixed response, high voices and commotion. Before leaving he said that he would be safely away from the settlement.<ref name="jk" />

The cantina was probably ruined along with the rest of the Fort in the [[battle of Fort Nowhere]].<ref name="jk" />
